map.只是标准，各家实现差异很大：日期函数、字符串拼接（|| vs CONCAT）、分: SQL is only a standard, and implementations differ greatly: date functions, string concatenation (|| vs CONCAT), pagination syntax (LIMIT vs TOP vs ROWNUM), and window-function support all vary. When working across databases, use the most basic syntax and isolate differences in the application layer or migration scripts.
